mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 2.5% signals inflationary pressure that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion of housing starts (HOUST) above 650 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) above 350000 million dollars signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In 70% or more of periods meeting HOUST > 650 and RSAFS > 350000, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 10% and employment (PAYEMS) rises above 130000 thousand, labor market recovery supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of periods meeting UNRATE < 10.0 and PAYEMS > 130000, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 3-month moving average signals expanding economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains above its 3-month moving average for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) value exceeding 700 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as a leading indicator of economic growth.
failure_condition: HOUST > 700 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) year-over-year is below 2.0%, accommodative monetary policy and stable inflation drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods meeting FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.0%, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 10% indicates improving labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains below 10% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.
